ai.summary: Google's Terms of Service now route EEA and Swiss users to Google Ireland Limited instead of Google LLC, and add EEA consumer guarantees, a 14-day withdrawal right, and local-court dispute rights. Key US-style protections also change: disputes now go to the laws of the user's home country rather than California, liability caps are reworded, and users get at least 15 days' notice of changes before they take effect, with changes deemed accepted unless they object.
